title: Learn the task loss while preserving readiness assumptions
statement: The version-2 finite rational learner uses quadratic net approximation for a protection-relevant task loss under the fixed complete-joint algebra; version3 interleaves three private roles. Accepted correctness is subnormalized and can coexist with permanent rejection outside the model. Readiness and source-exposure rate are family-conditional and do not become practical throughput.
